  "concordance_definition": "The paper states: 'Though we did not perform a systematic review to estimate clinical effect sizes for sunitinib against various malignancies, a perusal of the clinical literature suggests little relationship between pooled effect sizes and demonstrated clinical activity.' This implies a lack of concordance.",
  "limitations_stated": [
    "Relied on what authors reported in the published study.",
    "Relied only on published reports, and restriction of searches to the English language may have excluded some articles.",
    "Effect sizes were calculated using graph digitizer software from tumor volume curves: minor distortion of effect sizes may have occurred but were likely non-differential between groups.",
    "Subtle experimental design features—not apparent in ‘Materials and methods’ sections—may explain our failure to detect a dose–response effect.",
    "Few reports provide detailed animal housing and testing conditions, perhaps leading to important inter-laboratory differences in tumor growth.",
    "Study was exploratory in nature; findings like ours will need to be confirmed using prespecified protocols.",
    "Study represents analysis of a single drug, and findings may not extend beyond receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitors, or sunitinib.",
    "Analysis does not directly address many design elements—like duration of experiment or choice of tissue xenograft—that are likely to bear on study validity.",
    "Possible funding constraints that limit implementation of validity practices."
  ],
  "funding_conflict": null,
  "key_numbers": [
    "74 studies eligible for extraction",
    "332 unique experiments investigating tumor volume response",
    "174 experiments (52%) effect sizes could not be computed due to inadequate reporting",
    "158 experiments, involving 2716 animals, were eligible for meta-analysis",
    "Overall pooled SMD for all extracted experiments across all malignancies was −1.8 [−2.1, −1.6]",
    "Mean duration of experiments used in meta-analysis was 31 days (±14 days standardized deviation of the mean)",
    "6% of experiments investigated a dose–response relationship (3 or more doses)",
    "58.8% of experiments included active drug comparators",
    "4 genetically engineered cancer models used",
    "0 spontaneously arising tumors used",
    "Sunitinib effect sizes were significantly greater when active drug comparators were present in an experiment compared to when they were not (−2.2 [−2.5, −1.9] vs −1.4 [−1.7, −1.1], p-value <0.001)",
    "65.8% of individual experiments showed statistically significant activity at the experiment level (p < 0.05)",
    "Average sample size of 8.03 animals per treatment arm",
    "Average sample size of 8.39 animals per control arm",
    "Trim and fill analysis suggests an overestimation of effect size of 45% (SMD changed from −1.8 [−2.1, −1.7] to −1.3 [−1.5, −1.0]) across all indications",
    "Overestimation was 11% for high-grade glioma",
    "Overestimation was 52% for breast cancer",
    "158 experiments (n = 158) from all malignancies tested failed to show a dose–response relationship",
    "24 experiments (n = 24) for RCC subset failed to show a dose–response relationship",
    "98 experiments (30% of qualitative sample) could not be quantitatively analyzed because sample sizes or measures of dispersion were not provided",
    "11% preclinical cancer studies submitted to a major biotechnology company withstood in-house replication"
